soft_issues: Figures 1-12 and appendix 6 decision-base screenshots are images. Chart values used in claims are taken from surrounding prose or from readable OCR of axis labels, not from screenshot pixels.
There is still no single official definition of a routine (kurant) case. Counties have asked for one since 2005. Curation uses the authors' established practice, not an invented definition.

Table 3 raw-file counts can differ from the decision base. Møre og Romsdal 2023 is 14 in the Excel file and 30 in the decision base. County-level table 3 means are therefore not used as standalone claims.
Minus-time registrations for Kystverket and the Fisheries Directorate before 2024 pull some actor means down. The authors note the practice change from 2024.
One Vestland 2023 non-routine mean of 173 weeks rests on two cases. That figure is reported as an illustration of mean sensitivity, not as a typical county time.

claim_checks.claim: From 1 January 2010 counties took over allocation of aquaculture permits from the Directorate of Fisheries, plus objection authority for aquaculture in municipal area plans. For locality clearance the county coordinates the process and makes the final decision. Salmon, trout and rainbow trout remain a two-step process (company permit, then site). Other species apply for species, site and biomass together.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Med virkning fra 1. januar 2010 fikk fylkeskommunene gjennom forvaltningsreformen overført tildelingsmyndigheten for akvakulturtillatelser fra Fiskeridirektoratet, i tillegg til innsigelsesmyndighet på vegne av akvakultur i kommunale arealplanprosesser.

claim_checks.claim: The 2010 reform aimed to strengthen the regional elected level, improve coordination, strengthen industry development, and support more comprehensive coastal-zone planning. Processing deadlines were introduced at the same time. Rogaland was the only county that was not positive about the transfer. The Directorate estimated 11 full-time equivalents. Counties staffed more than that. Over half of the new staff came from the Directorate.
claim_checks.extract_quote: De fleste fylkeskommunene, utenom Rogaland fylkeskommune, var positive til overføringen av nye oppgaver

claim_checks.claim: The evaluation used document studies, FAKS decision-base statistics for 2020-2023, and 36 interviews with 38 informants (counties, municipalities, sector authorities, and industry) from October 2024 to January 2025. Two interviews were pairs. The rest were individual. The authors observed a FAKS gathering and a coordination meeting but do not quote those meetings. 2024 figures were left out because they were not yet reported.
claim_checks.extract_quote: I perioden oktober 2024-januar 2025 ble det gjennomført 36 dybdeintervjuer med totalt 38 informanter

claim_checks.claim: The report states that counties largely met the delivery goals, especially delivery capacity, competence, and quality. External partners and industry generally praise coordination. Adding the county is said not to have made applications more cumbersome. Some sector-authority informants question the balance between industry interests and environmental concerns.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Evalueringen viser at fylkeskommunene i stor grad har vist god måloppnåelse, særlig med hensyn til deres leveringsevne der forvaltningsoppgavene oppfattes utført med god kapasitet, kompetanse og kvalitet.

claim_checks.claim: The deadline regulation sets a 22-week total for locality applications. Counties have no sanctions if other bodies overrun. For routine (kurante) cases, mean processing time was 21 and 20 weeks in 2020-2021, then 24 weeks in 2022 and 31 weeks in 2023. About 80 percent of applications were routine. New-site means were 56, 42, 50 and 79 weeks. Change-of-site means were 22, 21, 24 and 27 weeks. All-case means were 30, 26, 30 and 38 weeks. Medians for all cases were 20.7 to 23.7 weeks. More than 85 percent of applications were granted in 2021-2023.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Gjennomsnittlig saksbehandlingstid på kurante saker var i 2020-2022 på henholdsvis 21, 20 og 24 uker, men økte til 31 uker i 2023.

claim_checks.claim: Counties themselves largely kept the four-week final-decision deadline. Møre og Romsdal used 7.7 and 10.4 weeks in 2022-2023. Statsforvalteren used about 14-18 weeks in 2020-2022 and almost 24 weeks in 2023 (limit 4). Mattilsynet used 12.7 to 16.5 weeks. Municipal treatment sat a few weeks over the 12-week limit. Non-routine means were 53, 43, 55 and 66 weeks. One Vestland 2023 non-routine mean of 173 weeks rests on two cases.
claim_checks.extract_quote: 2023 har statsforvalteren en gjennomsnittlig tidsbruk på nesten 24 uker, og mellom 14 og 18 uker

claim_checks.claim: Cod aquaculture decisions rose from 7 in 2020 to 30 in 2023. Salmon, trout, and rainbow trout still dominate. The coded set for the seven main counties is 1 141 change-or-new-site cases (853 routine, 279 non-routine, 874 changes, 267 new sites). Vestland had the most cases in the period. Nordland had 89 in 2020. Applications have become more complex, with more documentation and more coastal competition.
claim_checks.extract_quote: statistikken viser også at det har det vært en økning i vedtak for akvakultur av torsk, fra 7 vedtak i 2020 til 30 vedtak i 2023.

claim_checks.claim: FAKS, informal from 2010, pre-project in 2015 and formalised in 2016, is described as central for shared practice, knowledge, reporting, and equal treatment. From 2016 all counties have delegated decision authority to the administration. Table 1 shows 565 Nordland and 280 Troms political treatments in 2010-2016, then a sharp drop. Only two decisions were changed in political treatment in 2010-2018.
claim_checks.extract_quote: I høyre side av tabellen ser vi at totalt er det i disse periodene kun 2 vedtak som har blitt endret i politisk behandling.

claim_checks.claim: Informants agree that locality structure along the coast needs improvement, but they do not agree on solutions. Stronger state steering and stronger regional or local coordination are both discussed. The county is said to lack the tools to change existing site structures. Industry informants say old gentleman's agreements on where to apply no longer hold, and that firms apply to keep others out. Counties cannot see the Directorate's historical capacity-utilisation data.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Databasen til Fiskeridirektoratet gir en god visualisering av hvordan produksjonen har vært utnyttet over tid, men denne er ikke tilgjengelig for fylkeskommunene.

evidence_direction_note: not_applicable. The report evaluates county administration after 2010. It does not claim or contest a stated causal effect.
priority_questions_note: A2 and A6 remain core. After the full walk A1 (municipal plans, objections, inter-municipal processes, Havbruksfondet for knowledge) and A4 (plan-versus-licence mapping, missing capacity-utilisation data, missing kurant definition) are present. A3 and A5 are not tagged. Coastal competition and blocking applications appear, but other-use trade-offs and density biology are not the object.
